name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 59 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 42 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2026-04-06, at wavelengths from 0.87 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
